title: Cannibalization Report
description: Output contract of CANNIBALIZATION.md (module 15, PLAN phase). Reports the overlap of a proposed new article against existing CMS pages, the resulting risk level (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH), and the recommended action. Only emitted when a real cms_inventory was available; every existing_pages entry must come from that inventory - no URLs or pages may be invented.

new_article.description: The proposed article as submitted to the cannibalization check.

primary_keyword.description: Primary keyword the proposed article targets.

existing_pages.description: Inventory pages with meaningful overlap against the proposal. Empty when no overlapping page exists (risk LOW). Every entry must exist in the provided cms_inventory.

items.description: One existing page and its overlap with the proposal.

url.description: URL or slug of the existing page exactly as it appears in the cms_inventory.

title.description: Title of the existing page exactly as it appears in the cms_inventory.

primary_keyword.description: Primary keyword of the existing page as recorded in the cms_inventory; empty string when the inventory records none.

intent.description: Search intent of the existing page per SEARCH-INTENT.md.

shared_subtopics.description: Subtopics shared between the proposal and this page, listed explicitly.

overlap_summary.description: One-to-two-line summary of how this page overlaps the proposal (keyword, intent, topic signals).

risk_level.description: Cannibalization risk: LOW (different primary keyword AND different intent, or minor subtopic overlap only), MEDIUM (same intent with different angle/keyword variant, or meaningful shared subtopics), HIGH (same primary keyword AND same intent).

recommendation.description: The prescribed action. HIGH: improve_existing / merge / change_intent / change_angle / abandon (preference order). MEDIUM: differentiate (with the differentiation stated in rationale). LOW: proceed.

rationale.description: Why this risk level and recommendation: the triggering overlap signals, and for MEDIUM the required explicit differentiation statement.

data_availability.description: Which inputs were real when the report was generated.

cms_inventory.description: True when the report was generated against a real cms_inventory. This schema is only instantiated when true; an unavailable inventory produces no report object (the brief records cannibalization as UNAVAILABLE instead).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report generation.

existing_pages.title: How to Store Fresh Basil
existing_pages.overlap_summary: Different primary keyword and different core question; freezing is a minor subtopic of the existing page, not its core.

examples.rationale: Different primary keyword and a peripheral subtopic overlap only. Proceed, keeping the new article focused on freezing depth, and cross-link both pages so the overlap stays complementary.
